title: Being able to change the order of appearance of links in the sidebar
body:
Espacially for guides, I'm forced to add an ID to the header of the `guides.md` in order to not break the JS.

If I do so, the first link should be "intro" but strangely, it's in 3rd position, so I'm forced to rename the page "Guides Introduction" in order to make it appear first in the sidebar list.
